prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create six beautiful, comforting ENVIRONMENT illustrations for a preschool woodland fairy-tale picture book, as a single atlas in exactly 2 columns and 3 rows, six equal full-bleed panels in row-major order. Warm premium semi-realistic 3D storybook painting, believable wood, plants, stone, fabric and soft lighting. Atmospheric yet bright and reassuring; a five-year-old will enjoy exploring each image. No characters or people in any panel. No written text, captions, numbers, logos, watermarks, inset panels or decorative frame.
Top-left panel: a graceful fairytale stone palace far behind a winding woodland path, sunlight and wildflowers, a small travel satchel near the path.
Top-right panel: cozy woodland cottage with its door open and warm yellow light inside, birds on the roof, a pretty flower garden and exactly seven small colorful hats hanging on seven hooks by the doorway.
Middle-left panel: cottage porch in morning, a tidy set of gardening/mining hand tools beside a trail into the wooded hills, fresh greenery and soft mist.
Middle-right panel: a wicker basket of red apples on the rustic cottage doorstep beside a small wooden stool, soft afternoon light, ONE apple resting on a cream cloth.
Bottom-left panel: interior of the cozy wooden cottage, sunshine through a clean sparkling window, a safe warm tea-table setting and flowers; quiet comforting waiting scene.
Bottom-right panel: same cottage's colorful flower garden on a sunny day, a round picnic table set with exactly seven little cups and a big bunch of fresh flowers, cheerful birds and butterflies.
Strict grid: six single-view scenes, one scene per cell. Each cell's focal objects entirely within that cell. Consistent cottage architecture.
